sar.narrative: Customer C06224, holder of card C06224-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-31 22:43 and 2016-12-31 23:55, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,399.87 were made on the card online from device profile 'MacOS | Mac OS X 10_9_5 | chrome 66.0 | 2560x1600': $499.92 (3590539, 2016-12-31 22:43), $499.94 (3590651, 2016-12-31 23:26), $400.01 (3590730, 2016-12-31 23:55). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. When contacted, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because: 3 online purchases within 71 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($499.92, $499.94, $400.01; total $1,399.87). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-4169, CC-4086, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retaining the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: The requested verification settled it: the cardholder denied the activity, raising the probability to 0.97. Further graph steps would not change the actions (policy 6).
